subject: Weekly MAP: legal/procurement gate status + order form blockers
content:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Devon Park <devon@novushealth.com>; Procurement Team <procure@novushealth.com>
Cc: Karthish Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly MAP: legal/procurement gate status + order form blockers

Hi Devon / Novus procurement team —

Quick MAP checkpoint from our side following today's internal sync. Goal: make the gate review tomorrow clean so we can push the order form and vendor setup the same week. Key bullets below and attached is an action tracker with owners/due dates.

Status highlights:
- MSA redlines: Redwood submitted v3 redline yesterday; legal (Lauren) provided high-level comments. There are 3 outstanding commercial points (data residency, indemnity cap, audit window) and 2 security controls items to confirm.
- Order form: pricing and term lengths agreed in principle. Need billing contact and PO number on Novus side to generate order form.
- Vendor setup: cloud vendor account provisioning requested; CloudVendor needs SOW sign-off + billing contact before environment creation.

Proposed next steps (tomorrow's gate meeting):
1) Lauren to confirm final MSA carve for indemnity/cap with suggested language (owner: lauren_bishop, due: 2027-05-11 10:00 PDT).
2) Karthish to prepare a narrow fallback clause for data residency that can be accepted for initial deployment (owner: karthik_iyer, due: 2027-05-11 12:00 PDT).
3) Novus to provide billing contact + PO by end of day 2027-05-11 so order form can be generated (owner: Devon Park).
4) Sean to coordinate vendor onboarding checklist with CloudVendor and confirm expected env-ready date (owner: sean_gallagher, due: 2027-05-13).

Attachments: 20270510_MAP_action_tracker.xlsx (action tracker), Novus_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (redline with comments).

Can everyone confirm owners/dates or flag any blockers?

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

---

From: Karthish Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Devon Park <devon@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP: legal/procurement gate status + order form blockers

Thanks Tessa — quick update from product/procurement side:
- Data residency fallback: I can propose a phased approach (initially us-east with contractual guarantee of migration path + timeline). Will draft language and include an SLA escalation ladder for compliance checks.
- Indemnity cap: legal prefers a $5M cap; customer previously asked for unlimited. I'll document a compromise with carveouts for gross negligence.
- Technical eval: we finished the eval runbook; no major blockers but need CloudVendor to confirm account permissions for KV-cache warm-up jobs.

I'll drop the language into the tracker and route to Lauren this morning.

-Karthik

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthish Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP: legal/procurement gate status + order form blockers

Karthik / Tessa —

I reviewed v3 redline and left inline comments on the document (see Novus_MSA_redline_v3.pdf). High-level asks:
- Audit window: customer requested 90 days; Redwood policy is 30 days but can scope to SOC reports + attestation for 90 days. Need confirmation from Novus on exact scope (logs vs. full dataset).
- Indemnity: propose $5M cap with carveouts for willful misconduct & third-party IP — I've flagged acceptable language.
- Data residency: accept phased approach only if migration commitment and liquidated damages are included (suggested wording in the tracker).

If Novus can confirm acceptance of the audit scope and provide billing contact, we can greenlight the order form.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

---

From: Devon Park <devon@novushealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@novushealth.com>, Karthish Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP: legal/procurement gate status + order form blockers

Thanks all —

Quick responses:
- Billing contact: sending to procurement@novushealth.com; primary billing owner is Claire Xu (claire.xu@novushealth.com). We'll provide PO by EOD Tue 2027-05-11.
- Audit scope: agree to SOC reports + attestation for the first 90 days; we can revisit after pilot.
- Data residency: phased approach acceptable provided migration commitment is in MSA.

I can join the gate meeting tomorrow if helpful.

Regards,
Devon Park
Head of Cloud Procurement
Novus Health

From: CloudVendor Sales <sales@cloudvendor.io>

Cc: Devon Park <devon@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor provisioning request for Novus Health (RD-992)

Sean / Tessa —

We can provision the environment once we have: (1) countersigned SOW or order form, (2) billing contact and PO, and (3) completed onboarding questionnaire (attached). Estimated time-to-ready after those items: 4 business days.

Attachment stub: CloudVendor_Onboarding_Questionnaire.docx

- Sales, CloudVendor

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthish Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Devon Park <devon@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP: legal/procurement gate status + order form blockers

Summary and confirmed actions after today's check:
- Lauren: finalize the MSA language for indemnity/audit/data residency (due 2027-05-11 10:00 PDT).
- Karthish: draft fallback data residency clause + SLA ladder (due 2027-05-11 12:00 PDT).
- Devon / Novus: provide billing contact (Claire Xu) and PO by EOD 2027-05-11.
- Sean: I'll run the vendor onboarding checklist and confirm CloudVendor's expected env-ready date once PO/order form is countersigned (target 2027-05-17).

Open risks: PO delays may push provisioning beyond May 17. If PO not in by Tue EOD, escalate to Devon's VP and request provisional billing hold to start SOW steps.

I'll update the action tracker and share an updated version post-gate meeting. Please reply-only-if-blocked.

Sean Gallagher
Customer Success - Onboarding
Redwood Inference
